definitions.explanation: To carry something and come with it to the speaker's location. A compound of 持つ (to hold) + くる (to come).

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}、{写真|しゃしん}を{持|も}ってきてください。
{友達|ともだち}がお{土産|みやげ}を{持|も}ってきてくれた。
examples.english: My friend brought me a souvenir.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
Conjugates as くる (irregular): {持|も}ってくる → {持|も}ってきた (past) → {持|も}ってこない (negative) → {持|も}ってきて (te-form).

CONTRAST WITH {持|も}っていく:
- {持|も}ってくる: to bring (toward the speaker)
- {持|も}っていく: to take (away from the speaker)

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. Takes を for the object being brought.

ASPECT:
{持|も}ってきている means someone has already brought something and it is here now.
